pictures.name: QX1-Bare-Hill
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A bare, rocky hill just outside the stone walls of ancient Jerusalem under a heavy grey sky, three tall empty wooden crosses standing small and far away on top, a Roman road below with a few travelers hurrying past with their heads down. Somber, still. No people on the crosses.

pictures.name: QX2-Carrying
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A narrow stone street in ancient Jerusalem. A strong North African man in a traveler’s striped robe, Simon of Cyrene, carries a heavy wooden crossbeam on his shoulder, his face full of reluctant compassion. Ahead of him, Jesus, a man in a plain off-white robe with a soft brown mantle, shown ONLY from behind or as a far figure, his face never visible, walks slowly, seen from behind, his head bowed. Women in dark head coverings weep at the roadside. A Roman soldier in a red cloak leads the way. No blood, no wounds.

pictures.name: QX3-Forgive
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. The hill of the crucifixion seen from low down and behind the central cross: only the tall dark wooden beam and a silhouette against a stormy sky, no face, no wounds. At the foot of the hill, Roman soldiers in red cloaks kneel throwing dice for a seamless off-white robe; one soldier looks up, troubled. Grief and quiet mercy.

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Three crosses seen far away as small dark silhouettes on a hill against an unnatural darkness at midday, the sun dimmed behind thick clouds, a strange bronze glow on the horizon. The city walls in shadow. Awe, sorrow, stillness. No visible faces or bodies in detail.

pictures.name: QX5-Women-Watch
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. At dusk, on a slope below the hill, a group of women in dark blue and earth-colored head coverings stand together watching from a distance, holding each other, faces lit by the last red-gold light, eyes wet but steady. The crosses are only faint shapes far behind them. Faithful love that stays.

pictures.name: QX6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern hospital corridor at night. A tired nurse in blue scrubs pauses by a window and looks at a simple wooden cross on the wall of the hospital chapel doorway, one hand on her heart, a moment of stillness. Soft warm light in a cool blue hallway.
